title: MaleTheme Duo #017 · 남 맨즈 피지크·골드 글리터·천사 테마 / 남 피트니스 모델·펄 화이트 글로시·서퍼 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunny seaside promenade of pale paving stones with a waist-high white railing, a lamp post and a row of normal-height beach huts, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Indian man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a fresh-faced boy-group idol face with clear glowing skin, bright eyes and a gentle smile line, clean-shaven, metallic gold glitter eyeshadow with defined lashes, smooth warm brown skin with a soft glow, a calm gentle gaze, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in a classic French braid from the crown, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a gold cube-shaped block, a gold chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a lead ship's anchor, a tin pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked silver rings. Extremely long round nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: An extraordinarily tall and large man, far beyond any real person, with a men's physique build. Enormously broad shoulders with round capped deltoids, a wide upper chest tapering sharply to a very narrow waist in a dramatic V-taper, a lean sharply defined six-pack abdomen with visible obliques, thick strong arms, and long lean athletic legs that are muscular but not bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a thin golden halo floating above his head, a pair of large white feathered angel wings attached at his back, and a minimal white satin with gold trim T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme white platform stiletto ankle boots, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Nigerian man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, pearly white eyeshadow with a clear gloss lip and soft blush, deep rich dark-brown skin with a smooth satin glow, a bright open smile showing his teeth, vivid copper-orange hair styled in a sleek wet-look slicked straight back, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long gold chain ending in one large faceted pearl-cluster drop, and on the other ear a large copper hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a gold cube-shaped block, a bronze teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver hammer head, a gold ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered platinum hair ornaments. Extremely long square nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: A tall, extraordinarily well-built athletic man, far beyond any real person in size, built like a fitness model. Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a shark-tooth necklace and a minimal neon-orange T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, soaked and clinging, water streaming down his whole body in glistening rivulets with countless droplets clinging to his skin, his hair soaking wet and slicked.
RIGHT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme white plain stiletto pumps with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
